title: Waterfall x Bailey
description: A custom mod for minecraft java 1.21.1 with the neoforge mod loader to add custom discs inside the Waterfall x Bailey set of servers!
body:
**WATERFALL X BAILEY**
Howdy! welcome to the official mod for the Waterfall x Bailey set of servers
This mod was put on here so that i can push it to the various members of the server to be able to update the mod from our launchers!

This mod adds in 40+ music discs, a handful of items, and a new block and villager pofession to go with it!
